prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 678px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 677px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者根据 API 错误码和错误信息定位原因，并查找对应的解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描首列错误码或次列错误信息，找到对应行后横向阅读含义和解决办法；行内文字换行应保持各行之间清晰可辨。","groups":["错误码与错误信息共同用于识别问题，应便于快速扫描并保持标识完整。","含义与解决办法共同用于排查：前者解释原因，后者指导操作，均可自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["五位数字错误码","INVALID_CREDENTIAL 等错误信息标识","AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 等技术标识"],"may_wrap":["含义中的中文解释可在自然语义处换行。","解决办法中的说明可换行；较长的解决办法形成的行高也可容纳同一行含义的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [70, 175, 140, 292] · table 678×1384px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 176, 199, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [70, 175, 130, 302] · table 678×1361px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 176, 176, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [70, 175, 155, 277] · table 678×1430px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整、易于纵向扫描；含义与解决办法的宽度分配较均衡，行之间也容易区分。","problems":"含义列换行频繁，首行末尾只剩“配。”；部分解决办法也以单字收尾，阅读节奏略显零碎。","cause":"含义列140px仅有119px文字宽度；解决办法列292px的换行位置也使个别段落留下短末行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"识别列保持完整；解决办法更宽，45009行缩短，整体比r1A紧凑，操作说明也较容易连续阅读。","problems":"含义列更窄，短行和断句更明显，例如40003行末尾只剩“位。”；40125的解决办法末尾也只剩“方。”。","cause":"含义列130px仅有109px文字宽度；解决办法列302px虽较宽，但当前断行位置仍造成个别单字末行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"含义列更从容，解释文字的行长和语义连续性有所改善；识别列仍保持完整。","problems":"解决办法列显得拥挤，多个操作段落换行增多，首行末尾只剩“试。”；所有数据行同高但较长，形成大块空白，尤其在识别列。","cause":"含义列增至155px，使解决办法列降至277px；较窄的操作列拉高多行，含义列增加的空间未能抵消这一影响。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2-balanced","widths":[70,175,135,297],"change":"在r1A和r1B之间取中间值，给含义列多一点呼吸空间，同时保留较宽的解决办法列，检查能否改善短末行。"},{"name":"r2-action","widths":[70,175,125,307],"change":"进一步加宽内容最密集的解决办法列；含义列仍保留104px文字宽度，足以容纳其最长技术标识，观察操作段落是否更顺畅以及解释列是否过窄。"},{"name":"r2-meaning","widths":[70,175,145,287],"change":"略微加宽含义列，缓解r1A中解释文字的碎片化，同时避免r1C对解决办法列压缩过多。"}]}
